summary: Build practical contractor safety controls from prequalification through corrective action. Practise scorecards, permits, audits, and mobilisation planning.
lede: Contractor safety management training helps HSE, contractor, project and site managers control risks across external-workforce activities. Participants practise assessing contractor risk and competence, preparing mobilisation and permit interfaces, verifying field controls, and tracking incident learning and corrective actions through audit planning and performance scorecards.
audienceIntro: Contractor safety management training suits professionals who select, prepare, supervise, assure, or report on external workforces across complex operational environments. It is appropriate for beginners with safety or operational responsibilities and for experienced managers who need a more consistent contractor-control system.
prerequisites: Prior experience in HSE, project delivery, procurement, facilities, construction, energy, mining, manufacturing, or operational supervision is useful. You should be able to read basic risk assessments and workplace procedures. No coding or programming is required. Advanced digital topics receive operational application treatment, including how to use digital records, dashboards, and AI-assisted evidence screening without building software or machine-learning models.
